# Requirements Quality Checklist: 单文件竞赛测试套件（评分最大化）

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit-specify` as a requirements-quality review artifact.
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality; it does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Content Quality

- [x] CHK001 No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs) — 本特性的交付物就是测试套件，JUnit 5、JaCoCo、PIT 与嵌套分组是评分口径与交付形态，不是产品实现方案；规格未包含方法签名、测试代码或实现步骤。
- [x] CHK002 Focused on user value and business needs — 四个用户故事分别对应评分正确性、进度判定、引擎契约与端到端一致性。
- [x] CHK003 Written for non-technical stakeholders — 使用行为、状态、边界与可度量结果描述，不要求读者理解内部实现。
- [x] CHK004 All mandatory sections completed — User Scenarios & Testing、Requirements、Success Criteria 均已填写。

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK005 No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain — 规格中没有未决澄清标记；默认值已写入 Assumptions。
- [x] CHK006 Requirements are testable and unambiguous — FR-001 至 FR-012 均给出可判定的约束；边界值、异常类型与稳定码已明确。
- [x] CHK007 Success criteria are measurable — SC-001 至 SC-007 均包含百分比、耗时、失败数或可归因数字。
- [x] CHK008 Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details) — 度量口径由评分规则固定为分支覆盖与变异杀死；未出现产品实现方案。
- [x] CHK009 All acceptance scenarios are defined — 每个用户故事均给出 Given/When/Then 场景。
- [x] CHK010 Edge cases are identified — 评分、进度、QUIZ 回写、引擎与全局状态的边界均已逐条列出期望行为。
- [x] CHK011 Scope is clearly bounded — 唯一交付文件、只读边界、禁止新增依赖与测试文件均已写明。
- [x] CHK012 Dependencies and assumptions identified — 仓库、技术栈、评分权重、基线、离线环境与版本控制限制均已记录。

## Feature Readiness

- [x] CHK013 All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria — 每条 FR 均可由用户故事或边界清单中的行为判定。
- [x] CHK014 User scenarios cover primary flows — P1 评分主链路、P2 进度与回写、P3 引擎契约、P4 端到端均已覆盖。
- [x] CHK015 Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria — 覆盖率、变异杀死率、耗时、确定性与可归因性均有对应要求。
- [x] CHK016 No implementation details leak into specification — 未提供测试代码、断言示例或产品实现方案；仅保留类名、状态码与评分工具名称。

- 规格中的 `PrefixExpressionOperation` 分支数沿用输入基线 47；若后续以 `target/site/jacoco/jacoco.csv` 重新取数，应在计划阶段更新该数字。
- `src/main` 的类数沿用输入基线 53；实际统计口径以评分方提供的报告为准。
